name: Bakaara Market
subtitle: Bakaara (also spelled Bakara or Bakhara) is Mogadishu's major marketplace, in the Hawlwadag district.

facts.label: Origins
facts.value: Formerly residential, later a business hub

facts.label: 2007 fire
facts.value: A fire in October 2007 burned a large part of the market

parts.text: Bakaara (also spelled Bakara or Bakhara) is Mogadishu's major marketplace, in the Hawlwadag district. It grew from a residential area into a commercial hub.
